prior_art.fabric: Beetle / Arria-class FPGA fabric (air_fpga + part05_fpga.bin) coupled over AXI-HPS-to-FPGA bridge

gaps: eab_driver.ko does not exist, so the stage's named ioctl entry point has no bytes
no FPGA bitstream exists, so no Arria 10 subband mask register can be read
subband in ame_core.ko is OFDMA (ofdma_subband_type beside ofdma_en/start/len), not a puncturing mask
the two mask hits are GEM interrupt masks; the eleven null hits are null-CPE scheduling, not tone nulling
tone, notch and punctur appear 0 times in ame_core.ko
the real fabric control surface is the EAB ISR/helper family in ame_core.ko and the 195 FPGA mailbox symbols recorded by Stage 376A, which this stage does not re-derive
